# t14 — Product, Cart & Coupon JSPs

## Summary
5 JSPs created for products (list with pagination/search/filter, detail, notfound), cart (view with coupon apply form), and coupons (available list). All Struts tags migrated to JSTL/EL. Layout follows t6 template pattern. CSRF token field uses `_csrfToken` per constitution. Product list uses card grid matching screenshot.
